headline: 🔴 TrueConf KEV: Head Mare APT trojanizes meeting clients, 🎯 LockBit 5 claims U.S. Bank, ⚠️ Microsoft Entra ID CVSS 10.0 RCE, 🛡️ BTR.sys weaponized Defender driver bypasses EDR, 🔓 Rust crate supply chain hits hundreds of millions of downloads, 📋 SilkParasite APT deploys 5 new RATs via Google Drive C2
summary: CISA added two critical TrueConf Server vulnerabilities to the KEV, confirming Head Mare APT exploitation via trojanized meeting clients. LockBit 5 claimed a U.S. Bank attack with a September 3 deadline. Microsoft disclosed a CVSS 10.0 deserialization RCE in Entra ID. Researchers weaponized Defender's signed BTR.sys driver to bypass EDR at boot.
